en.headline: Police arrest 58-year-old man over Tai Po Fu Shin Estate robbery of elderly man
en.dek: Police said a 58-year-old local man was arrested on Friday afternoon in connection with Wednesday's robbery in which an 84-year-old man was attacked and lost gold ornaments and cash worth about HK$650,000.
body: Police arrested a 58-year-old local man on Friday afternoon in Tai Po in connection with a robbery that occurred on Wednesday at Fu Shin Estate.

According to police, an 84-year-old man was returning to his flat in Shin Mei House around noon on Wednesday when he was pushed from behind, assaulted and robbed of gold ornaments he was wearing and a wallet containing about HK$20,000 in cash. The total value of the stolen items was about HK$650,000. The victim sustained facial and head injuries and was taken to hospital conscious.

Investigators reviewed CCTV footage and the Sharp Eye system and determined that the suspect, who lived in the same building, had been tracking the victim in the estate beforehand. When the victim returned home, the man took another lift to a higher floor to lie in wait and attacked him.

Police found clothing believed to have been worn during the offence and receipts for the sale of the gold items inside the suspect's unit. Officers are tracing the proceeds of the crime. The man has been detained and will be charged with robbery.

A police inspector described the act as cold-blooded and urged residents to stay alert, safeguard their belongings, watch for strangers following them and report suspicious persons loitering in buildings to police.

zh.headline: 警方大埔拘捕58歲男子 涉富善邨長者行劫案
zh.dek: 警方表示周五下午在大埔拘捕一名58歲本地男子，他涉嫌與周三富善邨一名84歲長者被襲及搶去約65萬元金飾現金有關。
body: 警方周五下午在大埔區拘捕一名58歲本地男子，涉嫌與周三在大埔富善邨發生的一宗針對長者的行劫案有關。
據警方稱，一名年約84歲的長者周三中午返回富善邨善美樓寓所時，被人從後推跌及徒手襲擊，並搶去身上金飾及一個內有約兩萬元現金的銀包，財物總值約65萬元。事主面部及頭部受傷，清醒送院治理。
人員翻查閉路電視及「銳眼」系統後，相信疑犯與受害人住在同一幢大廈，早前曾在邨內跟蹤事主，待事主返家時搶先乘搭另一部升降機到較高樓層埋伏，然後下手作案。
警方在被捕人單位內檢獲懷疑犯案時所穿衣物及變賣金飾的單據，正追查贓款下落。該名男子現正被扣查，將被暫控一項行劫罪。
警務人員形容賊人行為冷血，強烈譴責，並呼籲市民提高警覺、妥善保管財物、留意有否可疑人士跟蹤，如發現大廈有可疑人物徘徊應立即報警。
